prompt: Why should the two jars remain separate?
promptZh: 為什麼這兩罐不要混在一起？

options.text: They contain different shades of white.
options.zh: 它們是不同色調的白色。
options.whyZh: 男子說看起來是同一種白色，女子沒有以色調區分。

options.text: They need to be returned to two different shops.
options.zh: 得退回兩家不同的商店。
options.whyZh: 兩罐帶來交換，沒有提到要退貨。

options.text: The paints dry with different finishes.
options.zh: 兩罐漆乾燥後的表面效果不同。
options.whyZh: 一罐有光澤，另一罐消光，因此不能視為相同油漆混合。

options.text: Only one jar has been opened.
options.whyZh: 女子明確依漆面效果決定分開，不是依兩罐是否開封。

explanationZh: 一罐有光澤，另一罐消光，因此不能視為相同油漆混合。
evidence: Keep them separate. One label says it dries shiny and the other says it dries flat. Offer the one with a readable label as it is.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Keep them separate. One label says it dries shiny and the other says it dries flat. Offer the one with a readable label as it is.
